svg.aria-label: AB763 SUPER REVERB-STYLE · EYELET BOARD LAYOUT — redrawn board layout diagram, layout-sheet drafting style
svg.text: AB763 SUPER REVERB-STYLE · EYELET BOARD LAYOUT

Redrawn from Fender 'SUPER REVERB-AMP AB763' LAYOUT drawing (C-FD, Fender Electric Instrument Company, Fullerton) — read from Schematic Heaven's 300 ppi scan (3299 × 2551), cross-checked against the EL34World capture (2182 × 1394) — not a trace

Heater layer: this drawing establishes its 5 V circuit against the amplifier's own sheet; the rest of the heater wiring it does not. At the centre-tapped valves (V1, V2, V3, V4, V5, V6) it shows the two heater pins on opposite supply legs — the 12.6 V series
arrangement; a 6.3 V supply straps them into one leg and returns on the centre tap. Which sockets sit on the chain, and the order it reaches them in, are not affected.
Note: the 6.3 V heater twisted pair always routes on the top layer and never joins another run — its crossings are not hop-overs.
6.3 V heaters — twisted pair (leg grouping not established)
